lede: Tuesday is the one to watch: a newly seated Town Council takes up second reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code, meaning a vote on actual land-use and landscaping standards could happen that day. Also Tuesday, the Housing Authority works through a primary-residency policy question for dependents in split-custody households — a real edge case that matters to families trying to qualify. Thursday, Planning and Zoning digs into the Carhenge Redevelopment and other Town-owned projects in the A2 zone, with subdivision and concept review on the table.

notable.stake: Council votes second reading on wildfire code changes to land use and landscaping rules.
Housing Authority sets policy on primary residency for dependents in multi-custodial households.
P&Z reviews subdivision and concept plans for Carhenge and other Town-owned A2-zone projects.
